blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate representation of turbulent flows requires simultaneously capturing multi-scale spatial structures and the complex, nonlinear coupling between distinct physical quantities (\textit{e.g.}, velocity components and density). In practice, however, turbulent data are often constrained by low spatial resolution due to hardware limitations and computational costs. While current data-driven super-resolution methods have shown promise by learning mappings via convolutional neural networks (CNNs), they typically treat physical variables as independent channels. This simplified approach neglects intrinsic cross-variable correlations, causing models to struggle with high-fidelity reconstruction, particularly under extremely sparse conditions or in out-of-distribution regimes. To bridge this gap, we propose an architecture-agnostic spatial-physical coupling operator that extends the standard convolution into a joint spatial-variable dimension. Unlike conventional linear channel mixing, our framework constructs a unified spatial-physical representation within CNNs to explicitly capture local inter-variable interactions. By lifting features into a higher-dimensional manifold, this operator significantly enhances the model's representation capacity. Experiments demonstrate that this approach enables strong reconstruction performance and zero-shot generalization, offering a physics-aware inductive bias for super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulence. More broadly, this work suggests that high-dimensional operators offer a promising avenue for modeling intricate multi-scale turbulent flows.
blocks.zh: 准确反映动荡流动需要同时捕捉多尺度空间结构以及不同物理量(\textit{例如}、速度组件和密度)之间的复杂、非线性耦合。 但实际上,由于硬件的限制和计算成本,动荡的数据往往受到低空间分辨率的限制。 虽然目前的由数据驱动的超解析方法通过进化神经网络(CNNs)来学习映射显示有希望,但它们通常将物理变量视为独立的通道. 这种简化的方法忽略了内在的可变相关性,导致模型与高忠诚度重建相去甚远,特别是在极其稀少的条件下或分配外的制度下. 为了弥合这一差距,我们提议建立一个结构-不可知的空间-物理耦合操作员,将标准演化扩展到一个空间可变的联合维度。 与传统的线性通道混合不同,我们的框架在CNN内部构建了统一的空间-物理代表,以明确捕捉出局部可变相互作用. 这个操作员通过将特性提升到一个更高维多维度,大大提高了模型的能见度. 实验证明,这种方法能够使重建性能强和零发普通化,为超解三维扰动提供物理学意识的还原偏差. 更广泛地说,这项工作表明,高维操作员为模拟复杂的多尺度动荡流动提供了有希望的途径。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Turbulent flow is a ubiquitous phenomenon characterized by its three-dimensional, unsteady, chaotic, and multi-scale nature [ 49 ] . High-resolution flow fields are central to both experimental and computational fluid dynamics, and underpin a broad range of applications, including pollutant transport [ 28 ] , combustion [ 51 ] , aerospace [ 40 ] , and oceanography [ 29 ] . In many practical scenarios, however, such high-resolution flow data remain difficult to obtain due to limitations in sensing resolution, storage, and computational resources, resulting in spatially under-resolved observations.
blocks.zh: 涡流是一种无处不在的现象,其特点是三维的,不稳定的,混乱的,和多尺度的性质[49]. 高分辨率流场是实验和计算流体动力学的核心,是广泛应用的基础,包括污染物运输[28]、燃烧[51]、航空航天[40]和海洋学[29]。 然而,在许多实际情况下,由于在感知分辨率、存储和计算资源方面的限制,这种高分辨率流数据仍然难以获得,导致空间分辨率不足的观测。

blocks.en: High-fidelity numerical methods, such as direct numerical simulation (DNS), which resolves the full energy cascade governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), and large eddy simulation (LES) [ 41 ] , which resolves the energy-containing scales while modeling subgrid-scale dynamics, are widely used for turbulent-flow analysis. However, their computational cost is often prohibitive. Recently, rapid advances [ 4 , 52 , 53 ] in machine learning (ML) for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have significantly expanded the range of methodologies, including data-driven surrogates [ 33 , 43 ] , physics-informed surrogates [ 48 ] , and ML-assisted numerical solvers [ 45 , 36 , 9 ] . The rapid accumulation of turbulence data ( e.g. , JHTDB [ 32 ] , AirfRANS [ 3 ] , and BLASTNet [ 12 ] ) has paved the way for ML approaches that can complement conventional experimental and numerical methods. In this study, we focus on using ML to reconstruct turbulent flows from spatially low-resolution three-dimensional compressible flow fields.
blocks.zh: 高精度数值方法,如直接数值模拟(DNS)解决了部分微分方程(PDEs)规范的全能级联,大eddy模拟(LES)[41]解决含能尺度同时模拟子网格尺度动力学,被广泛用于波动流分析. 然而,其计算费用往往令人望而却步。 最近,用于计算流体动力学(CFD)的机器学习(ML)的快速进步[4,52,53]大大扩大了方法的范围,包括数据驱动代位[33,43],物理知情代位[48],以及ML辅助数字解析器[45,36,9]. 动荡数据(如JHTDB[32]、Airfrans[3]和BLASTNet[12])的迅速积累为能够补充常规实验和数字方法的ML方法铺平了道路。 在这项研究中,我们侧重于利用ML重建来自空间低分辨率三维压缩流场的动荡流.

blocks.en: Super-resolution (SR) [ 55 ] has been of fundamental importance in many real-world applications, including medical imaging [ 25 ] , face hallucination [ 26 ] , and surveillance [ 65 ] , among others. In general, SR is highly challenging and inherently ill-posed, as the inherent information loss during degradation allows for an infinite manifold of high-resolution reconstructions to satisfy a single low-resolution observation. The advancement of deep learning has significantly driven the development of SR models, enabling them to attain state-of-the-art results on a wide range of benchmarks. Within this landscape, CNNs [ 35 , 66 , 15 ] exploit local receptive fields and translation equivariance to model local structures, while Transformers [ 34 , 7 , 31 , 38 ] employ self-attention mechanisms to capture global dependencies. More recently, state space models (SSMs) [ 22 , 21 ] have emerged as a promising paradigm for efficient long-range context modeling.
blocks.zh: 超级分辨率(SR)[55]在许多现实世界应用中一直具有根本重要性,包括医学成像[25],面部幻觉[26],监视[65]等等. 一般而言,斯洛伐克共和国具有高度挑战性,而且本身存在缺陷,因为在退化期间固有的信息损失使得可以进行无限的多层次高分辨率重建,以满足单一的低分辨率观测。 深入学习的进步大大推动了斯洛伐克共和国模式的发展,使它们能够在广泛的基准方面取得最新成果。 在此地貌中,CNN[35,66,15]利用本地的可接受领域和翻译等效性来模拟本地结构,而变形器[34,7,31,38]则利用自我关注机制来捕捉全球的依赖性. 最近,国家空间模型[22、21]已成为高效的远程环境模型的有希望范例。

blocks.en: While general-purpose deep learning models have achieved remarkable success in natural image tasks, directly transferring them to turbulent-flow data often encounters performance bottlenecks. This is because super-resolution in fluid dynamics requires more than visual sharpness: the reconstructed fields should preserve turbulence-relevant statistics, derivative-sensitive structures, and the coupled behavior of physical variables induced by the governing equations.
blocks.zh: 虽然通用的深度学习模型在自然图像任务上取得了显著的成功,但直接将其转移到动荡的流数据时常遇到性能瓶颈. 这是因为在流体动力学中的超分辨率需要的不仅仅是视觉锐度:重建的字段应当保存与流体相关的统计,衍生物敏感结构,以及支配方程引发的物理变量的偶联行为.

blocks.en: To bridge the gap in physical awareness within general architectures, researchers have begun exploring customized deep learning solutions tailored to fluid dynamic characteristics. These approaches aim to enhance reconstruction performance through the integration of physical priors and specialized operator designs. Consequently, a body of research specifically dedicated to fluid super-resolution has emerged [ 19 , 4 , 37 , 2 ] . A seminal work by Fukami et al. [19] introduced the hybrid downsampled skip-connection/multi-scale (DSC/MS) model on the canonical decaying homogeneous two-dimensional turbulent flow fields. Moreover, Kim et al. [27] attempted unsupervised learning of turbulence with CycleGAN [ 67 ] . Cao et al. [6] proposed quaternion spatial modeling and dynamic fluid convolution to facilitate more precise perception of turbulence. Recently, Zeng et al. [64] explored a multi-scale Transformer for turbulent channel flow. There are also many neural operator methods [ 14 , 1 , 42 , 43 ] . For example, Oommen et al. [43] proposed an adversarially trained neural operator (adv-NO) for both forecasting and reconstruction. Physics-informed loss functions [ 62 , 13 , 59 , 8 , 44 ] also play an important role in maintaining physical consistency and supporting data-assimilation frameworks. For instance, Yousif et al. [62] enforced physical constraints through loss terms based on flow gradients, the Reynolds stress tensor, and the spectral content. Page [44] incorporated a differentiable flow solver, enabling trajectory-level constraints to be imposed during training. Recent studies have also explored alternative training strategies to improve generalization and reduce data dependence. Fukami and Taira [20] showed that super-resolution models can be trained using only single-snapshot flow fields. Wu et al. [59] proposed EC-SRGAN, a multi-stage, multi-scale, and physics-informed workflow. Wu et al. [58] further introduced SoZoGAN, a scale-oriented zonal framework for zero-shot SR of unsteady flows with accuracy, robustness, and cross-domain generalizability.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补一般架构内在体能认知方面的差距,研究人员开始探索适合流体动态特征的定制深层学习解决方案. 这些方法旨在通过整合实物前科和专门的操作员设计,提高重建绩效. 因此,出现了专门研究流体超分辨率的研究机构[19、4、37、2]。 Fukami等人的开创性作品. [19]在犬科衰变的同质二维动荡流场上引入了混合式下取样的跳动连接/多尺度(DSC/MS)模型. 此外,Kim et al. [27] 尝试与CycleGAN一起无监督地学习动荡. [67]. 曹 al等编. [6] 拟议的四角形空间模型和动态流体演化,以便于更准确地认识动荡。 最近,曾等编著. [64] 探索多尺度变形器,用于动荡的信道流量. 还有许多神经操作方法[14, 1, 42, 43]. 例如,Oommen et al. [43] 提出一个经过对抗训练的神经操作员(adv-NO),用于预测和重建. 物理知情损失函数[62、13、59、8、44]在保持物理一致性和支持数据同化框架方面也发挥着重要作用。 例如,Yousif等人[62]根据流量梯度、Rynolds压力拉伸度和光谱含量通过损失条件强制实施物理限制。 第[44]页包含一个不同的流量解析器,使得在培训期间能够施加轨迹层面的限制。 最近的研究还探索了其他培训战略,以改进一般化和减少数据依赖。 Fukami和Taira [20] 显示超级解析模型只能使用单弹弓流场进行训练. 吴等. [59] 提出了EC-SRGAN,这是一个多阶段、多规模和物理学信息化的工作流程。 吴等. [58] 进一步引入了SoZoGAN,这是一个面向零镜头的分区框架,以准确性,稳健性,跨域通用性为零的流速SR.

blocks.en: A central architectural question in multi-field turbulence super-resolution is how to effectively represent and filter coupled physical quantities—such as density and velocity components—when observations are severely under-resolved. Standard 3D CNNs treat different physical fields as unstructured channels and rely on dense channel-wise summation within each spatial neighborhood, without sharing spatial filtering structures across variable features. This limitation becomes particularly acute under extreme coarsening ratios such as 32 × 32\times , where the low-resolution input retains only 1 / 32 3 ≈ 0.003 % 1/32^{3}\approx 0.003\% of the target grid points. Motivated by this challenge, we investigate whether organizing coupled flow variables along an explicit feature axis with shared spatial–variable kernels can improve multi-scale reconstruction and generalization at comparable parameter budgets.
blocks.zh: 在多场扰动超分辨率中,一个中心建筑问题是如何在观测严重解不开时,有效地表示和过滤结合的物理量——例如密度和速度组件。 标准的3D CNN将不同的物理领域作为无结构的信道,并依靠每个空间街区内密集的频道-顺理成章的归纳,而不共享跨越可变特征的空间过滤结构. 这一限制在32×32\时等极端折合比率下变得特别尖锐,低分辨率输入只保留了目标网点的1/32×3(0.003%)约0.003×(0. 受这一挑战的驱使,我们调查沿着一个具有共享空间-可变内核的明确的特征轴组织组合的流变,是否能够在可比参数预算中改善多规模的重建和概括。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce a joint spatial-physical modeling framework based on four-dimensional convolution (Conv4D). Rather than collapsing physical variables into the channel dimension, we retain an explicit variable-feature axis alongside the three spatial axes and apply shared 4D kernels across the resulting joint domain. While high-dimensional convolution itself is an established mathematical operation, our contribution lies in formulating it as a structured spatial–variable parameterization for compressible-flow super-resolution, together with tailored 4D channel-attention and dimension-selective PixelShuffle modules that preserve the variable-feature representation throughout EDSR and RCAN backbones.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们采用了基于四维演化(Conv4D)的空间-物理联合模型框架. 我们不但没有将物理变量倒入通道维度,而是在三个空间轴的同时保留一个明显的可变地貌轴,并在整个产生的联合域应用共享的4D内核. 虽然高维演化本身是一个既定的数学操作,但我们的贡献在于把它编成一个结构化的空间-可变参数化,用于压缩流超分辨率,以及定制的4D通道注意和维度选择性的像素Shuffle模块,这些模块在整个EDSR和RCAN骨干中保留了可变特征的表示.

blocks.en: The proposed operator can be seamlessly integrated into representative SR architectures ( i.e. , EDSR [ 35 ] and RCAN [ 66 ] ) and evaluated on 3D compressible turbulent datasets [ 11 ] . Experimental results demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and generalization capability, including zero-shot transfer [ 60 ] to unseen flow regimes. These findings suggest that the joint spatial-physical high-dimensional operator provides a more suitable inductive bias for learning representations of turbulence. Moreover, we highlight the potential of high-dimensional operators for modeling turbulence. The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. In Sec. II , we present the formulation of the 3D turbulent flow super-resolution problem, along with the proposed operator, model architectures, and dataset details. In Sec. III , we evaluate the performance of the reconstruction models and provide analysis of the results. Finally, Sec. IV concludes the paper.
blocks.zh: 提议的操作员可以无缝地融入有代表性的SR架构(即EDSR[35]和RCAN[66]),并在3D可压缩的动荡数据集上进行评估[11]. 实验结果表明重建精度和通化能力得到提高,包括零射转[60]到看不见的流量系统. 这些研究结果表明,联合空间-物理高维操作员为学习扰动表现提供了更合适的诱导偏差. 此外,我们强调高维操作者在模拟动荡方面的潜力。 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 在第二节中,我们介绍了3D动荡流超解问题的表述,以及提议的操作员、模型结构和数据集细节。 在第三节中,我们评价重建模式的业绩,并分析结果。 最后,文件第四节结束。

blocks.en: II.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 二.1 动机

blocks.en: Reconstructing under-resolved turbulent flows requires recovering correlated multi-scale structures across multiple interacting physical fields. While physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) [ 5 ] incorporate physical priors through loss-level constraints during training, here we explore a complementary architectural bias: organizing physical variables along an explicit feature axis and applying shared spatial–variable filters across that joint representation.
blocks.zh: 重建溶解不足的动荡流动需要恢复多个相互作用的物理领域的相关多尺度结构。 虽然物理知识神经网络[5]在培训期间通过损失级限制纳入物理前科,但我们在此探索一种互补的建筑偏差:沿着一个明确的特征轴组织物理变量,并在整个联合代表中应用共享的空间-可变过滤器。

blocks.en: In the compressible reacting and non-reacting flow configurations of BLASTNet 2.0 [ 11 ] , density and velocity fields are tightly coupled through the governing transport equations, such as the momentum equation ∂ t ( ρ u i ) + ∂ j ( ρ u i u j ) = − ∂ i p + ∂ j τ i ​ j \partial_{t}(\rho u_{i})+\partial_{j}(\rho u_{i}u_{j})=-\partial_{i}p+\partial_{j}\tau_{ij} . Two structural properties motivate our operator design. First, fundamental spatial differential operators ( e.g. , gradients ∇ \nabla and Laplacians ∇ 2 \nabla^{2} ) act uniformly on different scalar components using identical discrete spatial stencils on a Cartesian grid, which motivates sharing spatial filter weights across physical variables. Second, while physical couplings in the governing equations take the form of pointwise products such as ρ ​ u i ​ u j \rho u_{i}u_{j} (which a single linear convolution cannot directly compute), alternating joint spatial–variable convolutions with nonlinear ReLU activations across deep residual blocks enables the network to approximate these nonlinear multi-variable interactions within an expanded latent variable space.

blocks.en: Conventional 3D CNN super-resolution models [ 35 , 66 , 15 ] also learn nonlinear cross-variable relationships through stacked convolutions and activations, but they collapse the physical variables into unstructured channels at every layer without enforcing weight sharing along a dedicated variable axis. By contrast, preserving an explicit variable-feature axis of length L ′ L^{\prime} and sliding a shared 4D kernel across both spatial and variable-feature dimensions encourages the network to reuse spatial filtering patterns while maintaining distinct, coupled representations of the flow variables.
blocks.zh: 常规的3D CNN超级分辨率模型[35,66,15]也通过堆叠的演化和激活来学习非线性交叉可变关系,但是它们将物理变量分解为每层无结构的通道,而不强制使用专用可变轴进行重量共享. 与此相对照的是,保持长度L ' L^{\prime]的明显可变地轴,并在空间和可变地核两个维度上滑动一个共享的4D内核,鼓励网络重新利用空间滤波模式,同时保持流变体的不同,组合的表示.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the proposed EDSR and RCAN variants alternate these shared 4D convolutions with nonlinear activations inside residual blocks. Rather than identifying any single convolutional layer with an analytical Navier–Stokes flux, this architecture couples the physical variables at the representation level while maintaining high parameter efficiency through multi-dimensional weight sharing [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,拟议的EDSR和RCAN变体在剩余区块内与非线性激活取代这些共享的4D变体。 这个架构不是用分析的Navier - Stokes 通量来识别任何单一的演化层,而是在代表层次上将物理变量对等,同时通过多维量共享来保持高参数效率[30].

Here, the variable axis serves as a structured latent feature dimension rather than a geometric coordinate. While standard Conv3D layers collapse all variables through dense channel mixing at each step, the 4D convolution applies a shared kernel across both the three spatial axes and the expanded variable-feature axis ( L ′ L^{\prime} ). Sharing the kernel along this axis encourages the network to reuse spatial filtering patterns across different physical fields while capturing cross-variable correlations within a joint representation. Consequently, “locality” along the variable axis refers to finite-neighborhood feature aggregation in the projected latent space of length L ′ L^{\prime} , without assuming physical distance between the raw variables ( ρ , u , v , w ) (\rho,u,v,w) . blocks.en: Relation to existing convolutional variants. It is instructive to distinguish the proposed spatial–variable Conv4D from related convolutional designs. Spatiotemporal 4D convolutions [ 10 ] operate over three spatial coordinates plus time, whereas our additional axis indexes latent physical-variable features. Factorized ( 3 + 1 ) (3+1) D convolutions [ 50 ] decompose filtering into a spatial Conv3D followed by a 1D convolution along the fourth axis, imposing a separability constraint between spatial and cross-variable interactions; by contrast, a joint 4D kernel captures simultaneous spatial–variable neighborhoods without assuming rank-1 separability. Grouped convolutions [ 61 ] partition channels into independent groups without cross-group mixing or kernel tying across groups, while pointwise 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolutions mix channels without spatial context. By sharing a joint 4D kernel across both ( D , H , W ) (D,H,W) and the expanded variable axis L ′ L^{\prime} , our formulation acts as a structured weight-sharing prior over multi-variable flow representations.

blocks.en: II.3 Model details
blocks.zh: 二.3 示范细节

blocks.en: Conventional CNNs ( e.g. , Lim et al. [35] , Fukami et al. [19] , Zhang et al. [66] , Fukami and Taira [20] ) extract features through standard convolutions, as shown in Fig. 1 . The proposed operator is plug-and-play and can be seamlessly integrated into existing super-resolution networks. To validate the generalization of the proposed joint modeling approach, our operator is integrated into two well-studied deep residual learning [ 24 ] super-resolution architectures, i.e. , the enhanced deep super-resolution network (EDSR) [ 35 ] and the residual channel attention network (RCAN) [ 66 ] . The implementation details of the model are provided below.
blocks.zh: 常规CNN(例如,Lim等人) [35], Fukami等人著. [19], 张等. [66],Fukami和Taira [20])通过标准演化提取特征,如Fig所示. 1 (英语). 拟设的操作员是插件和游戏,可以无缝地融入现有的超分辨率网络. 为验证拟联合建模办法的统称,我国运营商整合为两套经过充分研究的深层剩余学习[24]超分辨率架构,即强化深层超分辨率网络[EDSR][35]和剩余通道关注网络(RCAN)[66]. 该模式的实施细节如下。

blocks.en: EDSR (Ours). As shown in Fig. 2 (a), the architecture avoids batch normalization to preserve the dynamic range and scale sensitivity of high-frequency turbulent structures. The network body consists of a cascade of residual blocks, each formulated as 𝒳 k = 𝒳 k − 1 + α ​ f 4 ​ D ​ ( σ ⁡ ( f 4 ​ D ​ ( 𝒳 k − 1 ) ) ) , \mathcal{X}_{k}=\mathcal{X}_{k-1}+\alpha\,f_{4D}\!\left(\sigma\!\left(f_{4D}(\mathcal{X}_{k-1})\right)\right), (9) where 𝒳 k − 1 \mathcal{X}_{k-1} denotes the input feature map to the k k -th residual block, f 4 ​ D f_{4D} denotes the proposed convolution operator, σ \sigma is the ReLU activation, and α \alpha is a residual scaling factor introduced to stabilize deep feature extraction.

RCAN (Ours). To further assess the proposed operator, we also investigate a second representative super-resolution backbone based on residual channel attention, namely RCAN, as shown in Fig. 2 (b). Compared with EDSR, RCAN introduces channel-wise feature recalibration, which is particularly useful when low-resolution inputs contain abundant low-frequency information, potentially limiting the representational capacity of the network. RCAN is composed of multiple residual groups (RGs), each of which contains a cascade of residual channel attention blocks (RCABs). blocks.en: II.4 Data and evaluation description
blocks.zh: 二.4 数据和评价说明

blocks.en: As one of the largest flow-physics datasets, the Johns Hopkins Turbulence Database (JHTDB) [ 32 ] contains 3D DNS data of turbulent incompressible non-reacting flows. Nevertheless, such datasets are restricted in scope, since they exclude compressible flows and reacting flows, which are essential in many aerodynamic, propulsion, and combustion-related applications. We conduct experiments on the bearable large accessible scientific training network-of-datasets (BLASTNet) turbulent flow super-resolution benchmark [ 12 ] . The data are derived from high-fidelity DNS of compressible turbulent flows, covering a wide range of physical regimes and configurations.
blocks.zh: 作为最大的流体物理数据集之一,约翰·霍普金斯涡流数据库(JHTDB)[32]包含了动荡的不可压缩非反应流的3D DNS数据. 然而,这种数据集在范围上受到限制,因为它们排除了压缩流和反应流,这些流动在许多空气动力学、推进和燃烧相关应用中是必不可少的。 我们试验了可承受的大型无障碍科学培训数据集网络(BLASTNet)的波动流超分辨率基准[12]。 数据来源于可压缩的动荡流的高真度DNS,涵盖广泛的物理制度和配置.

blocks.en: Specifically, the Momentum128 3D SR dataset [ 11 ] is constructed from BLASTNet 2.0 by extracting fixed-size 3D sub-volumes from uniformly discretized regions. Each high-resolution target is a 128 × 128 × 128 × 4 128\times 128\times 128\times 4 volumetric field comprising density and three velocity components on a regular Cartesian grid. The corresponding low-resolution input is generated through Favre filtering [ 47 ] followed by downsampling to 128 / N × 128 / N × 128 / N × 4 128/N\times 128/N\times 128/N\times 4 , where N N denotes the downsampling factor. The dataset contains 2,000 2{,}000 sub-volumes extracted from 27 DNS configurations. Following the standard benchmark split [ 11 ] , 1,382 1{,}382 samples are used for training, while the validation and Baseline Test Sets contain 173 173 samples each. For evaluation under distribution shifts, the Parametric Variation Set contains 144 144 samples from an unseen parametric configuration, and the Forced HIT Set contains 128 128 samples from an unseen forced homogeneous isotropic turbulence configuration. Accordingly, the Baseline Test Set evaluates in-distribution reconstruction, the Parametric Variation Set assesses robustness to parametric distribution shifts, and the Forced HIT Set evaluates generalization to a distinct flow.

blocks.en: III Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 三. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed operator with emphasis on both reconstruction accuracy and turbulence-relevant statistics. The analysis is organized as follows. First, we assess its reconstruction accuracy on the in-distribution Baseline Test Set using the EDSR backbone. Second, we examine zero-shot transfer to unseen flow regimes. Third, we evaluate robustness across upsampling ratios and model sizes. Finally, we test whether the operator generalizes to a stronger RCAN backbone and compare it with representative CNN-, Transformer-, and operator-based baselines.

blocks.en: III.1 Validation of turbulent flow reconstruction
blocks.zh: 三.1 动荡流重建的验证

blocks.en: As reported in Table 1 , the proposed operator generally improves the reconstruction accuracy of the ρ , u , v , w \rho,u,v,w task while maintaining a parameter count comparable to the EDSR3D baseline. The magnitude of the improvement varies across expansion dimensions and super-resolution ratios. At 8 × 8\times , the best variant improves the Baseline performance from 40.78 / 0.9146 40.78/0.9146 to 41.62 / 0.9256 41.62/0.9256 . At 16 × 16\times , the performance is further improved from 31.12 / 0.7202 31.12/0.7202 to 31.23 / 0.7317 31.23/0.7317 . The advantage becomes much more pronounced at 32 × 32\times , where the SSIM gain reaches 0.06 0.06 . These results indicate that introducing an explicit physical-variable dimension improves the recovery of fine-scale turbulent structures, and that the benefit becomes increasingly evident as the input becomes more severely under-resolved.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,提议的操作员一般提高 $, u, v, w , \rho, u, v, w 任务的重建精度,同时保持一个与 EDSR3D 基线相当的参数计数. 改进的程度因扩展层面和超分辨率比率而异。 8×8\时,最佳变体改善了基线性能,从40.78/0.9146 40.78/0.9146到41.62/0.9256 41.62/0.9256. 16\时,业绩由31.12/0.7202 31.12/0.7202进一步提高至31.23/0.7317 31.23/0.7317. 在32×32\时,优势变得更加明显,其中SSIM收益达到0.060.06。 这些结果表明,引入一个明确的可变物理层面有助于恢复细尺度的动荡结构,而且随着投入的解决程度越来越低,这种好处越来越明显。

blocks.en: The SGS-stress-divergence task in Table 2 provides a more stringent test because ∇ ⋅ 𝝉 s ​ g ​ s \nabla\cdot\bm{\tau}^{sgs} depends on filtered products of velocity and density and is therefore highly sensitive to local reconstruction errors. The proposed operator improves the SSIM of this derived quantity from 0.7116 0.7116 to 0.7382 0.7382 at 8 × 8\times , from 0.4352 0.4352 to 0.4933 0.4933 at 16 × 16\times , and from 0.1090 0.1090 to 0.1766 0.1766 at 32 × 32\times on the Baseline Test Set. We note that the PSNR of the SGS quantity does not improve monotonically in all extreme cases. This is expected because the SGS divergence amplifies local derivative errors and is dominated by intermittent high-gradient regions. Therefore, the combined PSNR/SSIM results should be interpreted as follows: the proposed operator does not uniformly reduce pointwise error everywhere, but it better preserves the structural organization of the SGS-related field, especially under severe coarsening, providing a stronger constraint than generic channel mixing.
blocks.zh: 表2中的SGS-stress-divergence任务提供了一个更严格的测试,因为 \\\ nnabla\cdot\ bm\ tau\ sgs} 依赖于速度和密度的过滤产品,因此对本地重建错误高度敏感. 提议的操作员在8x8x时改进了这种衍生数量的SSIM,从0.7116 0.7116提高到0.7382 0.7382,在16x16时从0.4352 0.43352提高到0.4933 0.4933,在基线试验集中从0.1090 0.1090提高到0.1766 0.1766。 我们注意到,在各种极端情况下,特别总公司数量的PSNR并没有单调改善。 由于SGS差异放大了本地衍生错误,并且以间歇性高梯度区域为主,因此预计会出现这种情况. 因此,综合的PSNR/SSIM结果应该解释为:拟议的操作者不会在任何地方统一减少点球误差,但最好能保留SGS相关领域的结构组织,特别是在严重收缩的情况下,提供比通用通道混合更强大的制约.

blocks.en: The qualitative observations further support the quantitative results. As shown in Fig. 3 , the wavenumber spectra of the instantaneous w w field show that our model remains notably closer to the DNS spectra than the baseline, especially in the intermediate- and high-wavenumber ranges, where fine-scale fluctuations are most difficult to recover. In contrast, the baseline tends to produce smoother and less detailed reconstructions, particularly when the low-resolution input is extremely coarse. Taken together, these results indicate that the proposed operator improves both numerical accuracy and physically relevant fidelity.

blocks.en: III.3 Sensitivity to variable ordering
blocks.zh: 三.3 对可变订单的敏感性

blocks.en: In our default setting, the input fields are ordered as ( ρ , u , v , w ) (\rho,u,v,w) . Because the initial 4D convolution uses a kernel of size k l = 3 k_{l}=3 with padding along the variable axis, it is natural to ask whether the reconstruction accuracy depends on this specific ordering. In practice, the first convolutional layer projects the four input fields into a learned latent variable space of size L ′ L^{\prime} , and the subsequent residual blocks progressively aggregate information across the entire variable-feature axis and channel dimension. To evaluate the sensitivity to input ordering, we trained and tested the proposed EDSR variant ( L ′ = 4 L^{\prime}=4 , 8 × 8\times ) under three representative permutations of the input variables, keeping all other hyperparameters unchanged. As summarized in Table 7 , the reconstruction metrics remain highly consistent across different variable permutations, demonstrating that the performance gains arise from the joint spatial-variable coupling mechanism rather than a particular ordering of the input fields.

blocks.en: III.4 Computational complexity
blocks.zh: 三.4 计算的复杂性

blocks.en: Although the proposed 4D operator maintains a parameter count comparable to its 3D counterpart through kernel sharing along the variable-feature axis L ′ L^{\prime} , sliding the convolutional kernel across this additional dimension increases the number of multiply–accumulate operations. Furthermore, because native 4D convolution kernels are not directly supported by cuDNN, our implementation realizes Conv4D by accumulating 3D convolutions along the variable axis. To quantify the resulting runtime overhead, we profiled the inference latency, peak allocated GPU memory, and FLOPs of all models in Table 6 under the 8 × 8\times setting ( 16 3 16^{3} input to 128 3 128^{3} output, batch size 1, FP32 precision) on a single NVIDIA Tesla V100S (32 GB) GPU, averaging inference time over 20 synchronized forward passes after warm-up. As shown in Table 8 , RCAN4D requires roughly 3.3 × 3.3\times the FLOPs ( 2185.81 ​ G 2185.81\text{ G} vs. 670.47 ​ G 670.47\text{ G} ), 2.4 × 2.4\times the peak memory, and 5.0 × 5.0\times the inference latency of RCAN3D, with a FLOP count comparable to those of the 3D Transformer baselines (SuperFormer and SwinIR3D), but higher measured latency and memory. Developing fused custom CUDA kernels for 4D spatial–variable filtering, as well as systematically comparing against factorized ( 3 + 1 ) (3+1) D separable and grouped convolutions across multiple random seeds, are promising directions for future investigation.

blocks.zh: 三.5 不同环境的强健性

In particular, the largest gain occurs at 32 × 32\times , where the mean PSNR increases by more than 4 ​ dB 4\text{ dB} over the 3D baseline, indicating that joint spatial–variable filtering is especially beneficial when the input observations are extremely sparse.

blocks.en: III.6 Backbone generalization of the proposed operator
blocks.zh: 三.6 拟议经营者的背骨一般化

blocks.en: The above experiments are all based on the EDSR backbone. To further verify that the observed gains are not architecture-specific, we also replace the standard convolutions in RCAN with the proposed spatial-physical coupling operator. For a fair comparison, all learning-based models are trained using the same training split and evaluated on the same three test sets under identical data preprocessing and evaluation protocols. In addition to comparing with the baseline RCAN, we further benchmark our method against a diverse set of approaches, including the CNN-based model (RRDB3D [ 54 ] ), the operator-learning method (Conv-FNO [ 57 ] ), and Transformer-based architectures (SuperFormer [ 18 ] , SwinIR3D [ 34 ] ). Specifically, Conv-FNO [ 57 ] is an operator-learning approach based on the Fourier Neural Operator, which models global spatial dependencies in the spectral domain by learning mappings between function spaces. However, it exhibits limited fidelity in reconstructing fine-scale structures. SuperFormer and SwinIR3D adopt Transformer-based architectures with window-based self-attention, but they do not incorporate physical inductive biases.
blocks.zh: 上述实验均以EDSR骨干为基础. 为了进一步核实观测到的收益不是针对建筑的,我们还用拟议的空间-物理耦合操作员取代RCAN中的标准演变。 为了进行公平的比较,所有基于学习的模型都通过相同的培训进行分门别类的培训,并在相同的数据处理和评价协议下在同一三套测试中进行评价。 除了与基线RCAN进行比较外,我们还将我们的方法与一套不同的方法作为基准,包括基于CNN的模型(RRDB3D [54]),运营商-学习方法(Conv-FNO [57]),以及基于变形器的架构(SuperFormer [18],SwinIR3D [34]). 具体来说,Conv-FNO[57]是一种基于Fourier神经操作器的操作员学习方法,它通过学习函数空间之间的绘图来模拟光谱域的全球空间依赖性. 然而,它在重建精细结构方面表现出的忠诚有限。 SuperFormer和SwinIR3D采用基于变形器的架构,具有基于窗口的自觉性,但并不包含物理诱导偏差.

blocks.en: As shown in Tables 5 and 6 , the RCAN-based variants generally yield improvements over the corresponding baseline. Notably, RCAN itself is a stronger backbone than EDSR, owing to its residual channel attention mechanism for more effective feature refinement. Therefore, the performance gain cannot be attributed merely to a particular residual-block design, but instead demonstrates the general effectiveness of the proposed operator across different super-resolution backbones.
blocks.zh: 如表5和表6所示,基于RCAN的变体一般比相应的基线有所改善。 值得注意的是,RCAN本身是比EDSR更强大的支柱,因为它的剩余通道关注机制可以更有效地改进特征。 因此,性能收益不能仅仅归因于某个特定的残余区块设计,而是表明拟议运营商在不同超分辨率主干线上的总体效力.

blocks.en: Across both the lightweight (Table 5 ) and full-scale (Table 6 ) RCAN settings, incorporating the proposed operator consistently improves over the corresponding RCAN3D baseline, with particularly pronounced gains at 16 × 16\times and 32 × 32\times . In Table 6 , RCAN4D also outperforms RRDB3D, Conv-FNO, SuperFormer, and SwinIR3D at 8 × 8\times and 16 × 16\times while using fewer parameters than the Transformer and RRDB baselines. At 32 × 32\times , the gains are less uniform: RCAN4D achieves a mean PSNR/SSIM of 23.45 / 0.6154 23.45/0.6154 , compared with 23.30 / 0.6135 23.30/0.6135 for RCAN3D and 24.16 / 0.6186 24.16/0.6186 for SwinIR3D. It also exceeds RRDB3D and Conv-FNO in both mean metrics, while SuperFormer has higher mean PSNR ( 23.83 23.83 dB) and lower mean SSIM ( 0.6125 0.6125 ). Thus, the proposed operator improves the corresponding CNN backbone but does not uniformly outperform all competing architectures at the most severe coarsening ratio.
blocks.zh: 在轻量级(表5)和全量级(表6)的RCAN设置中,纳入拟议的操作员比相应的RCAN3D基线持续改善,在16x16和32x32的时间内特别显著的增益。 在表6中,RCAN4D还比RDB3D,Conv-FNO,SuperFormer,和SwinIR3D在8×8时和16×16时都表现优于成绩,同时使用比变形器和RRDB基线更少的参数. 在32×32\时间,收益不太一致: RCAN4D实现平均PSNR/SSIM为23.45/0.6154 23.45/0.6154,而23.30/0.6135 RCAN3D23.30/0.6135,SwinIR3D24.16/0.6186 24.16/0.6186  for. 它在两个平均度量中也都超过了RRDB3D和Conv-FNO,而SuperFormer则有更高的平均值PSNR(23.83 23.83 dB)和较低的平均值SSIM(0.6125 0.6125). 因此,拟议的运营商改进了相应的CNN主干线,但并没有以最重的折合率统一超越所有竞争的架构.

blocks.en: Overall, the experiments show that the proposed operator improves not only image-style reconstruction metrics, but also several turbulence-relevant diagnostics, including the SGS-stress divergence, vorticity magnitude, Q-criterion, and velocity correlations. These observations are consistent with the design of the operator, which retains an explicit variable-feature axis and shares kernels over local spatial–variable neighborhoods. Therefore, the primary contribution is not merely an increase in network capacity, but a change in the inductive bias used to represent coupled flow variables.

blocks.en: III.7 Scope and limitations
blocks.zh: 三.7 范围和限制

blocks.en: While our evaluations demonstrate consistent improvements in reconstruction accuracy, derived momentum and SGS quantities, and turbulence statistics, these diagnostics measure statistical and structural fidelity rather than strict enforcement of conservation laws. Incorporating explicit conservation constraints when full spatiotemporal state variables are available remains an important direction for future work.

blocks.en: IV Conclusions
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en: In summary, we introduced an effective spatial-physical operator for three-dimensional turbulence super-resolution, jointly modeling interactions across spatial dimensions and physical variables in a higher-dimensional feature space. The proposed operator provides a more physically consistent inductive bias than conventional CNN-based methods. As a general-purpose operator, it can be readily incorporated into off-the-shelf super-resolution architectures and delivers performance gains across models.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们引入了三维扰动超分辨率的有效空间物理操作器,在高维特征空间共同模拟空间维度和物理变量之间的相互作用。 与传统的基于CNN的方法相比,拟议的操作员在物理上提供了更一致的诱导偏差. 作为通用运营商,它可以随时融入现成的超分辨率架构,并实现跨模型的性能收益.

blocks.en: Moreover, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed operator yields consistent improvements across multiple upscaling factors, with particularly pronounced advantages under severely under-resolved conditions. Additionally, the framework exhibits strong generalization capability, including robustness to variations in model parameters and zero-shot transfer to unseen flow regimes. The proposed operator is well aligned with the localized, nonlinear, and high-dimensional nature of turbulent interactions. The results also indicate that explicitly representing the spatial-physical manifold allows the model to learn more generalizable structural features of turbulence rather than overfitting to the statistical distributions of the training domain.
blocks.zh: 此外,实验结果表明,拟议操作人员在多种升级因素之间取得持续改进,在解决严重不足的条件下具有特别显著的优势。 此外,该框架显示出强大的通俗化能力,包括对模型参数变化的强烈性以及零射向无形流动系统的转移。 拟议操作员与动荡互动的局部、非线性和高维度性质完全一致。 调查结果还表明,明确代表空间-物理多元性,使模型能够学习更普遍的动荡结构特征,而不是过于适合培训领域的统计分布。

blocks.en: This study highlights the potential of high-dimensional operators as a principled mechanism for capturing multi-physics couplings. Future work will explore more efficient and effective operator designs. Such efforts may further narrow the gap between data-driven super-resolution and physics-based turbulence modeling.
blocks.zh: 本研究强调了高维操作者作为捕获多物理耦合物的原则机制的潜力. 今后的工作将探索更有效率和更有效的操作员设计。 这种努力可能会进一步缩小数据驱动的超分辨率和基于物理学的扰动建模之间的差距。
